gloss: the other party; on the other hand

definitions.gloss: the other party, the other side
definitions.explanation: Refers to the other person or group in a situation involving two parties.
Used as a conjunctive expression to introduce a contrasting or alternative viewpoint. More formal than {一方|いっぽう} in this sense.

examples.japanese: {他方|たほう}⟦の→の：09472_no⟧⟦{意見|いけん}→意見：01303_iken⟧⟦も→も：00484_mo⟧⟦{聞|き}く→聞く：00483_kiku⟧べきだ。
examples.english: We should also listen to the other party's opinion.

examples.japanese: ⟦{契約|けいやく}→契約：02698_keiyaku⟧⟦の→の：09472_no⟧{他方|たほう}⟦の→の：09472_no⟧⟦{当事者|とうじしゃ}→当事者：12504_toujisha⟧⟦に→に：00314_ni⟧⟦{通知|つうち}する→通知する：19645_tsuuchisuru⟧。
examples.english: Notify the other party to the contract.
There are voices in favor on one hand and against on the other.

examples.japanese: ⟦{経済|けいざい}→経済：01394_keizai⟧⟦は→は：00079_ha⟧⟦{成長|せいちょう}→成長：03290_seichou⟧⟦した→する：00392_suru⟧。{他方|たほう}、⟦{格差|かくさ}→格差：04839_kakusa⟧⟦も→も：00484_mo⟧⟦{広|ひろ}がった→広がる：01980_hirogaru⟧。
examples.english: The economy grew. On the other hand, inequality also widened.

examples.japanese: ⟦この→この：00962_kono⟧⟦{政策|せいさく}→政策：10070_seisaku⟧⟦に→に：00314_ni⟧⟦は→は：00079_ha⟧⟦{利点|りてん}→利点：11787_riten⟧⟦が→が：00051_ga⟧⟦ある→ある：00006_aru⟧。{他方|たほう}、⟦{課題|かだい}→課題：00132_kadai⟧⟦も→も：00484_mo⟧⟦{少|すく}なくない→少ない：01136_sukunai⟧。
examples.english: This policy has advantages. On the other hand, there are also considerable challenges.

examples.japanese: ⟦{都市部|としぶ}→都市部：14549_toshibu⟧⟦で→で：00502_de⟧⟦は→は：00079_ha⟧⟦{人口|じんこう}→人口：01618_jinkou⟧⟦が→が：00051_ga⟧⟦{増|ふ}えている→増える：01183_fueru⟧⟦が→が：00051_ga⟧、{他方|たほう}、⟦{地方|ちほう}→地方：02369_chihou⟧⟦で→で：00502_de⟧⟦は→は：00079_ha⟧⟦{減少|げんしょう}→減少：02719_genshou⟧⟦が→が：00051_ga⟧⟦{続|つづ}いている→続く：00903_tsuzuku⟧。
examples.english: The population is increasing in urban areas, but on the other hand, the decline continues in rural areas.

notes:
Often used in formal writing and academic contexts. When used as a conjunction, it typically appears at the beginning of a sentence or clause to present a contrasting point. Frequently paired with ⟦{一方|いっぽう}→一方：01739_ippou⟧ (one side/on one hand) in the pattern ⟦{一方|いっぽう}→一方：01739_ippou⟧⟦で→で：00502_de⟧⟦は→は：00079_ha⟧…{他方|たほう}⟦で→で：00502_de⟧⟦は→は：00079_ha⟧… (on one hand... on the other hand...).

COMMON PATTERNS:
- ⟦{一方|いっぽう}→一方：01739_ippou⟧⟦で→で：00502_de⟧⟦は→は：00079_ha⟧…{他方|たほう}⟦で→で：00502_de⟧⟦は→は：00079_ha⟧… (on one hand... on the other hand...)
- {他方|たほう}、〜 (on the other hand, ~)
